body: Each branch memory-map adjoint sends I to F_s; intervening memory-only CPTP adjoints preserve I. Backward induction yields product p_s*I for a specified string when every F_s is scalar. Under F_bad<=q*I, positivity instead bounds each specified bad step by a factor q, summing unspecified branches as trace preserving. Replace the current bad Pauli by identity while retaining its same positive memory map for the current q half-diamond comparison. None of this requires a finite-dimensional/forgetful bath; it does require the actual isolated port and trusted positive instrument.
